name: Church of Our Lady of Mount Carmel (Ouro Preto)
scope: The standing Church of Our Lady of Mount Carmel in Ouro Preto, including its curved Rococo frontispiece, rounded bell towers, tiled nave and rear range, and the principal stone approach stair.

originalReview.notes: The dated postcard shows the paired rounded belfries with gently domed roofs and carved finials, prominent banded cornice, central carved portal, round opening, cross and long stone stair. The local archive record binds the native front and back scans. The reverse bears the church name, collection stamp and date XII.1923.

review.method: Qualla-first review followed by the museum’s original native dated postcard and release
review.notes: The Qualla article was checked first. The railway photograph depicts another subject. The Argenton records refer to public-domain objects, while the actual photographs specify CC BY-SA. No photograph from the article was used. Both uncropped museum scans and the signed date were inspected, and the museum public-domain declaration applies to the exact antique postcard.
